name: Jira Team Status
description: Team backlog status view for sprint, stand-up, and team-orientation — what the team can pick up next, what is ready, blocked, in progress, unassigned, stale, or needs story work. Two readiness concepts are distinct: team readiness (default — scope + eligible state + no blocker + minimum definition) and agent-execution readiness (explicit optional lens using the five-question bar, activated only when the user asks for agent-ready or one-PR work). Output starts with scope, coverage, read-only confirmation, and summary counts before grouped sections. Paginates to completeness; always discloses coverage state. Triggers on 'show the team backlog', 'what can the team pick up', 'what is blocked', 'sprint status', 'stand-up summary', 'stale team work'. Routes story improvement to jira-story-triage; routes approved field changes to jira update-issue with explicit per-issue confirmation.

deps._runtime_contract: Sibling skills are addressed BY NAME at runtime. The agent's harness resolves the name to whatever install location the user picked. `source` below is install guidance only — never a runtime path.

skills.name: jira
skills.purpose: All Jira reads for the snapshot (check, search). Also the conditional bare pass-through update-issue when the user explicitly asks to set a field (payload confirmed first). Hard dependency — there is no degraded path without it.

skills.name: jira-story-triage
skills.purpose: Pick-up hand-off Option B — routes an item that needs detail to the skill that explains why and drafts a fix with write-after-approval. Soft dependency — when absent, the skill surfaces an install hint and gives the item key.

skills.name: jira-defect-flow
skills.purpose: Pick-up hand-off Option A for ready items whose issuetype is Bug or Defect. Soft dependency — when absent, the skill surfaces an install hint rather than stopping.

skills.name: new-spec
skills.purpose: Pick-up hand-off Option A for ready items whose issuetype is Story or Task. Soft dependency — when absent, the skill surfaces an install hint rather than stopping.

input.arguments: A Jira project key (required; one or several). Optional: sprint name or ID (default: open sprints), team name or JQL filter, or a whole-backlog scope. Optionally a repo URL or name for grounding.

artifacts: A team status report starting with a header block (scope, coverage, Jira-not-changed confirmation, summary counts), followed by grouped sections: §1 Ready to pull (team-ready; or agent-ready sub-group when that lens is explicitly active), §2 Needs story work, §3 Blocked, §4 In progress, §5 Other open work — plus cross-cutting flags (unassigned, stale, missing owner, dependency risk), §6 recommended next candidates with reasons, and §7 likely follow-up actions. Pick-up hand-off routes to jira-defect-flow (bugs) or new-spec (tasks/stories); story improvement routes to jira-story-triage. Confirmed bare pass-through update-issue for a single field on explicit user request only.
